image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) lying on a textured beige surface, likely a rug or blanket, with an orange/brown sofa in the background. The dog is facing forward, looking directly at the camera. It has characteristic long, wavy ears with rich chestnut markings, a white blaze on the forehead, and dark, expressive eyes. The coat is silky and predominantly white with large chestnut patches on the body and ears.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture appears silky and slightly wavy/straight rather than curly. Feathering is visible on the ears and front legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Although the dog is lying down, the visible torso suggests a compact build. The proportions of the head to the visible body align with a toy spaniel.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front left leg is extended and appears straight with fine bone structure. Feathering is visible on the lower part of the leg. Hindquarters are partially obscured but what is visible looks consistent.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not clearly visible in this specific pose as the dog is lying down and the rear is angled away/obscured by the body and background.
The subject is stationary (lying down), so gait cannot be evaluated.
